title: Progressive convergent engineering review
summary: A risk-first canonical review ledger preserves mandatory floors, promotes evidenced sweep concerns, publishes early immutable request-changes, repairs derivable metadata, caches exact infrastructure failures, converges by measured progress and derives isolated lens-quality telemetry.

current_state.summary: Taskplane already has signal routing, deep/light dispatch, v3 leases, promotion scaffolding, exact slot conservation, DoR/document classification, immutable partial collection, engine/worktree fingerprints, suite caching, host-parity UX and provider-correct spend. Debt remains over-widening, late blocker publication, metadata contradictions, repeated evaluator failure, global fix cap and sparse lens-value telemetry.

alternatives.name: Canonical progressive ledger
alternatives.description: Extend incumbent ReviewKernel with versioned risk, binding, cache, convergence and telemetry records.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: The lens catalog becomes small/cheap enough that exhaustive review is measurably faster without quality loss.

alternatives.name: Exhaustive up-front deep review
alternatives.description: Dispatch all applicable lenses before collection.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: A human explicitly selects forensic audit mode.

alternatives.name: Progressive without canonical partial revisions
alternatives.description: Schedule progressively but retain partial results only in memory.

decision: Extend existing ReviewKernel/storage/routing rather than add an authority: deterministic initial wave and promotions, immutable early revisions, exact evidence bindings, constrained repair/cache/retry, measured convergence, and post-review isolated telemetry.

contracts.description: Exactly-once lifecycle ledger for selected and promoted slots plus acceptance evidence.
Immediate immutable provisional request-changes with known evidence and explicit gaps.
One audited equivalence-bounded derivable metadata repair; substance retries affected slot.
Mandatory floors, evidence-deep lenses, <=1 sweep and deterministic promotion/rejection.
Exact-key expiring verified infrastructure-unavailable cache without lens verdict.
Measured finding/evidence progress and bounded continue/escalate decisions.
Post-review versioned quality/uniqueness/latency/cost telemetry isolated from current review.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC1: Code, docs-only, mixed, empty-map, high-risk, low-risk, and early-blocker fixtures always select and conserve every catalog-declared mandatory engineering-review floor.
acceptance_map.validation: Seven change-shape fixtures assert every catalog floor is selected and conserved.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC2: Representative small, large, code, configuration, and documentation changes dispatch mandatory floors, evidence-selected deep lenses, and zero or one bounded light sweep, with machine-readable n/a evidence rather than exhaustive catalog execution.
acceptance_map.validation: Five scale/type fixtures assert floors plus evidence-deep plus <=1 sweep and machine-readable n/a, never exhaustive dispatch.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC3: High/major, low/minor, duplicate, cross-charter, missing-evidence, and replay sweep fixtures prove deep promotion requires normalized risk, referenced evidence, rationale, in-charter trigger, deterministic slot identity, and idempotency.
acceptance_map.validation: Six sweep fixtures assert normalized risk/evidence/rationale/charter/idempotent deterministic promotion identity.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC4: Every admissible high/major sweep concern is promoted to its responsible deep lens or canonically rejected as duplicate, out-of-charter, invalid, or already covered; the light sweep never substitutes for the deep judgment.
acceptance_map.validation: Promotion ledger test asserts every admissible high/major is promoted or rejected by one canonical reason and never treated as deep verdict.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC5: Blocker-first, blocker-late, simultaneous, duplicate, mechanically repaired, and invalidated-finding fixtures prove an immutable provisional request-changes revision publishes as soon as blocking evidence is admissible with complete known evidence and truthful gate state.
acceptance_map.validation: Six blocker-order/repair/invalidation fixtures assert immediate immutable request-changes with all known evidence and truthful disabled gate.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC6: Mixed slot lifecycle fixtures reconcile every selected slot exactly as collected, running, undispatched, promoted-pending, missing, invalid, retrying, or infrastructure-unavailable in the provisional gap manifest and never label partial review exhaustive.
acceptance_map.validation: 0/1/several/all gap matrix asserts every selected slot has exactly one named lifecycle state and partial is never exhaustive.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC7: Removing or duplicating one prepared, dispatched, produced, validated, collected, promotion, or acceptance-evidence record keeps approval closed; only a complete exactly-once conserved ledger can proceed.
acceptance_map.validation: Mutation matrix removes/duplicates each lifecycle and acceptance record; only complete exactly-once ledger enables approval.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC8: Multi-revision fixtures prove later results, promotions, repairs, retries, dynamic evidence, and adjudications supersede provisional revisions immutably without losing or duplicating any previously valid finding, gap, provenance, or artifact identity.
acceptance_map.validation: Multi-revision round trip asserts immutable supersession with no lost/duplicate finding, gap, provenance or artifact id.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC9: Permuted, omitted-summary, contradictory-summary, empty, fail-with-findings, and pass-with-zero slot payloads normalize to one byte-stable verdict/count/severity/completion metadata representation or a named substantive inconsistency.
acceptance_map.validation: Six payload permutations assert byte-stable normalized metadata or named substantive inconsistency.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC10: Authoritatively derivable identity, count, summary, and schema metadata defects repair once with before/after, derivation authority, and fingerprint proof while target, view, evidence, findings, severity, rationale, action, verdict substance, lease, slot, and producer remain equivalent; any substantive mutation reruns only the affected slot.
acceptance_map.validation: Repair allowlist test proves one derivable repair with equivalence; substantive tamper invokes only affected producer.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC11: Identical evaluator, engine fingerprint/version, host capability, repository, exact worktree, and valid time window reuse one verified infrastructure-unavailable result without relaunch or lens verdict; changing any key, expiry, or repaired infrastructure invalidates the cache.
acceptance_map.validation: Cache-key matrix asserts one reuse only on exact evaluator/engine/capability/repository/root/window and invalidation on every key/expiry/repair.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC12: Root, linked-worktree, sibling, moved-root, symlink, clone, engine-skew, stale-head, copied-result, and resume fixtures verify canonical repository, exact Git worktree, target/base/head, engine, run, lens, slot, lease, and producer binding and reject substitution.
acceptance_map.validation: Nine repository/worktree/engine fixtures assert complete binding and reject symlink/sibling/clone/move/stale/copy/skew substitution.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC13: API docs, security guidance, runbook, user docs, changelog, typo-only, mixed code/docs, malformed-doc, and absent-map fixtures route from documentation evidence and do not widen to the full module-level catalog solely due to missing or inapplicable code mapping.
acceptance_map.validation: Nine document fixtures assert content/directive/contract/audience routing and no module-miss full-catalog widening.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC14: Ambiguous or corrupt documentation retains mandatory floors and produces the smallest evidence-backed explained widening set with a stable routing fingerprint, never no-review or unconditional all-lens routing.
acceptance_map.validation: Ambiguous/corrupt document fixtures retain floors and assert minimal explained widening with stable fingerprint.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC15: Fast convergence, three-plus-cycle convergence, no-progress, oscillation, regression, repeated-fingerprint, unsafe, scope-change, and human-stop fixtures record closed/persisted/regressed/new findings plus evidence progress and make deterministic continue/escalate decisions without a global two-cycle rule.
acceptance_map.validation: Nine convergence fixtures assert deterministic continue/escalate without a global two-cycle rule.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC16: Convergence score, cycle count, provisional request-changes, and cached failure can never auto-approve, abandon a required slot, widen implementation scope, or bypass a human-owned scope, destructive-action, or final-signoff decision.
acceptance_map.validation: Authority-negative suite asserts scores/caches/provisional state never approve, abandon, widen scope or bypass human gates.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC17: Each lens/run records eligible, selected, promoted, collected, admissible/confirmed/unique/overlap/duplicate/later-invalidated/false-positive findings, retries, repairs, latency, tokens/cost when available, and infrastructure unavailability with versioned definitions and denominators; golden arithmetic distinguishes unavailable from zero.
acceptance_map.validation: Per-lens arithmetic golden asserts every named numerator/denominator, version and unavailable-vs-zero semantics.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC18: Information-isolation fixtures show telemetry is derived only from sealed canonical revisions and later adjudication, does not expose one lens draft to another, alter current verdicts, or suppress mandatory floors, and yields identical substantive results when disabled.
acceptance_map.validation: Isolation A/B fixture disables telemetry and asserts identical substantive review; telemetry reads sealed revisions/adjudication only.

acceptance_map.criterion: AC19: Claude, Codex, managed worktrees, and supported fallbacks preserve the same review semantics, evidence, early revisions, conservation gate, repair, convergence, and telemetry definitions, and existing suites pass without removed, skipped, xfailed, loosened, or reclassified governance assertions.
acceptance_map.validation: Claude/Codex/worktree/fallback semantic goldens and test-audit assert parity and no removed/skip/xfail/loosen/reclassify changes.

risks.mitigation: Catalog floors are unconditional; promotions require attributable evidence; ambiguity widens minimally with explanation.

risks.risk: Early provisional output is mistaken for exhaustive approval-ready review.
risks.mitigation: Schema/gate require request-changes, explicit gap manifest and approval disabled.

risks.risk: Repair/cache forges substantive review or crosses worktrees.
risks.mitigation: Equivalence allowlist plus exact repository/root/engine/run/lease binding and expiry.

risks.risk: Convergence loops indefinitely or broadens scope.
risks.mitigation: Task bound, two no-progress threshold, oscillation/fingerprint/safety/scope/human escalation; no auto-approval.

risks.risk: Telemetry biases current producers or leaks data.
risks.mitigation: Derive only after sealed revisions/adjudication; no current-routing read edge; redact to bounded fingerprints/counts.

failure_modes.mode: Mandatory floor or promoted slot disappears.
failure_modes.detection: review_slot_ledger reports selected/promoted versus lifecycle conservation.
failure_modes.recovery: ReviewKernel aborts approval immediately and retries only named missing slot within Plan bound.
Routing owner records canonical rejection; admissible concern is promoted once, never substituted.

failure_modes.detection: review_metadata_repair reports before/after equivalence and allowlist result.
failure_modes.recovery: Recovery owner rejects repair and reruns affected slot only, maximum Plan retry bound.

failure_modes.mode: Infrastructure cache key is stale or mismatched.
failure_modes.detection: evaluator_health_cache reports full key, TTL and invalidation reason.
failure_modes.recovery: Evaluator owner invalidates and probes once; verified unavailable never becomes verdict.

failure_modes.mode: Fix cycles show no progress, oscillation, regression or unsafe scope change.
failure_modes.detection: review_convergence reports finding sets/evidence delta and decision reason.
failure_modes.recovery: Loop owner escalates after two no-progress cycles or immediately on unsafe/scope/human stop.

failure_modes.detection: lens_quality_metric reports definition version and availability.
failure_modes.recovery: Telemetry owner records unavailable, never zero, and does not affect review.

signals: review_slot_ledger: each selected slot lifecycle and acceptance evidence
alerts: Block approval on any ledger conservation or acceptance-evidence gap.
Block repair on substantive change or failed equivalence.
Invalidate health cache on any key/TTL/repair change.
Escalate after two no-progress cycles, repeated fingerprint, oscillation, regression, unsafe or scope change.

rollout.strategy: Behind TASKPLANE_PROGRESSIVE_REVIEW, dual-record ledger/bindings, then progressive routing/provisional publication, repair/cache, convergence, and post-review telemetry. Compare complete-review and Claude/Codex/worktree goldens each phase.
rollout.rollback: Disable new progressive sessions; finish issued leases with retained readers; preserve immutable revisions/telemetry; revert new reviews to current routing and task-plan fix bounds. No destructive migration or simultaneous host deployment.
